items.title: Is Salesforce (CRM) Cheap After AIforce And Koa Launches?
items.summary: Salesforce, the US software group behind a broad suite of CRM and AI tools, has seen a mixed share price ride in recent years, which raises a simple question for you as an investor: Is the current US$234.02 price adequately backed by the earnings power the company is generating today? Over the past 3 years, Salesforce shares have delivered a 17.1% gain, so anyone buying in now needs to judge whether the underlying earnings profile still matches that kind of performance.
